The '''Wetyin's Colony system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wetyin's Colony (planet)|Wetyin's Colony]].
